_description: Per-report budget of types referenced by a published surface but exported by no subpath of their own package. Only ever lowered — see scripts/check-api-nameable.mjs.
_step: step.api.md went 1 -> 2 for StandardSchemaResult, which `stepDelegate` drags in: it takes a SubagentDef, whose `tools` are ToolDefs, whose `inputSchema` is a Standard Schema, whose `validate` returns this. It is the same class as the `Literal` already budgeted here — a structural type an author reads in a tsc message and never writes — and it is unnameable from every authoring subpath, not just this one.
_coding: coding-tools.api.md arrives at 2, and both are the SAME class already budgeted above: `createCodingTools` answers a record of `ToolDef`s, so the report carries `ToolContext` whole — `Literal` (the step-name guard an author meets only as a tsc message) and `StandardSchemaResult` (what a tool's `inputSchema.validate` returns). Neither is nameable from any authoring subpath, and neither is a name a host writing `createCodingTools({ dir })` ever types.
